description: Search this account's leads by campaign/list, source, geography (city/state/county), lead type, tags, contact history (never_contacted / contacted_no_reply / replied) and SMS eligibility (textable phone, not opted out, not suppressed), with paging and a deterministic sort. Returns lead_id values plus masked contact details and per-lead eligibility flags. Read-only — SENDS NOTHING and changes nothing. This is the filter-rich sibling of list_leads (plain paging) and find_lead (locate one person); use the lead_ids it returns with add_leads_to_campaign, or let select_and_attach_leads run the same filters and attach a bounded subset in one step.

campaign_id.description: Only leads currently in this campaign/list (must be owned by this account).

contact_status.description: never_contacted = no opening SMS ever claimed for the lead and no reply on record.

has_phone.description: Filter on having any phone at all.

investor_type.description: Exact alias for lead_type — same field, same matching. Pass one or the other, not different values for both.

opted_out.description: Lead flag OR suppression-list match (phone-format tolerant).

sms_eligible.description: Textable phone (cell, not landline-only), not opted out, not suppressed. Send-time compliance still re-checks.

sort.description: Deterministic orders (ties broken by id). Default 'newest'.

source.description: Exact source label, case-insensitive, e.g. 'PropStream export'.

tags.description: Leads carrying ANY of these tags.

name: search_leads
title: Search leads with eligibility filters
